nodes.title: Part 1: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 1. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: A SysOps engineer configures a CloudWatch alarm to notify the operations team when EC2 CPU utilization exceeds 80% for 5 consecutive minutes. The alarm is in ALARM state and sends an SNS notification, but the on-call engineer reports they received no email. What is the MOST likely cause?
flashcards.back: SNS email subscriptions require the recipient to confirm the subscription by clicking a confirmation link. Without confirmation, the subscription is in 'Pending confirmation' state and no emails are delivered. Always verify all SNS email subscriptions are confirmed after setup.

flashcards.front: An application logs errors to CloudWatch Logs in the format 'ERROR: RequestId <id> Duration: <ms>'. The operations team wants a metric that counts the number of errors per minute to trigger an alarm. Which CloudWatch feature should the SysOps engineer use?
flashcards.back: CloudWatch Logs metric filters extract numeric values or count occurrences from log events and convert them into CloudWatch metrics. You define a filter pattern (e.g., 'ERROR'), optionally extract a value, and specify a metric name in a custom namespace. The resulting metric can then trigger a CloudWatch alarm.

flashcards.front: A company wants to ensure that all newly created S3 buckets in their AWS account have server-side encryption enabled. The SysOps team needs to be automatically notified when a non-compliant bucket is found and see compliance history over time. Which solution meets these requirements?
flashcards.back: AWS Config continuously evaluates resource configurations against managed or custom rules. The 's3-bucket-server-side-encryption-enabled' managed rule detects non-compliant S3 buckets. Config maintains compliance history and can trigger SNS notifications or EventBridge events when compliance status changes. SCPs prevent creation but don't track existing buckets.

flashcards.front: A SysOps engineer needs to automatically stop an EC2 instance that has been in 'running' state for more than 24 hours without any active connections. The company wants to minimize idle compute costs. Which solution uses the LEAST operational overhead?
flashcards.back: EventBridge scheduled rules (cron-based) triggering SSM Automation documents provide serverless, low-maintenance automation. The SSM Automation document can check instance state (via describe-instances, connection metrics from CloudWatch) and stop qualifying instances. This requires no EC2-hosted logic or manual review — it runs entirely managed by AWS.

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer reviews CloudTrail and notices API calls from an unknown IP address creating IAM users with administrator privileges at 2 AM. The engineer needs to identify which AWS account credentials were used to make these calls. Which CloudTrail field contains this information?
pairs.option: userIdentity

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer configures a CloudWatch alarm to notify the operations team when EC2 CPU utilization exceeds 80% for 5 consecutive minutes. The alarm is in ALARM state and sends an SNS notification, but the on-call engineer reports they received no email. What is the MOST likely cause?
pairs.option: The SNS topic does not have an email subscription confirmed by the recipient

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer needs to configure Route 53 health checks so that traffic automatically fails over from the primary region to a secondary region when the primary becomes unhealthy. Which Route 53 routing policy should be used?
pairs.option: Geolocation routing with health checks configured for the primary region

pairs.stem: A company wants to ensure that all newly created S3 buckets in their AWS account have server-side encryption enabled. The SysOps team needs to be automatically notified when a non-compliant bucket is found and see compliance history over time. Which solution meets these requirements?
pairs.option: Use CloudTrail to detect CreateBucket API calls and trigger an SNS alarm through EventBridge

pairs.stem: An application logs errors to CloudWatch Logs in the format 'ERROR: RequestId <id> Duration: <ms>'. The operations team wants a metric that counts the number of errors per minute to trigger an alarm. Which CloudWatch feature should the SysOps engineer use?
pairs.option: An EventBridge rule that triggers on CloudWatch Logs new events matching the error pattern

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer configures a CloudWatch alarm to trigger an EC2 auto-recovery action when the system status check fails. The engineer also wants to be notified when the recovery is initiated. How should the notification be configured?
pairs.option: Add an SNS notification action to the same alarm that triggers the auto-recovery action

nodes.title: Part 2: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 2. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: A company uses RDS MySQL in a Multi-AZ deployment. During a maintenance window, the primary DB instance in us-east-1a fails. How long does the typical RDS Multi-AZ automatic failover take, and what is its impact on the connection string?
flashcards.back: RDS Multi-AZ automatic failover typically takes 60-120 seconds. During failover, RDS updates the DNS CNAME of the DB endpoint (e.g., mydb.cluster-xxx.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com) to resolve to the standby instance (now promoted to primary). Applications using the endpoint hostname (not hardcoded IP) automatically reconnect to the new primary after a DNS TTL expiry without any configuration change. the CNAME endpoint automatically resolves to the new primary, requiring no application connection string changes

flashcards.front: A SysOps engineer is setting up cross-region replication for S3 to support a disaster recovery strategy. The source bucket has existing objects that need to be replicated to the destination bucket. What steps are required to replicate the existing objects?
flashcards.back: S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) only replicates objects written after the replication rule is enabled. Pre-existing objects are NOT automatically replicated. To replicate existing objects, use S3 Batch Operations with the ReplicateObject operation, which processes existing objects and subjects them to the replication rules. This is the AWS-recommended approach for migrating existing data. CRR only replicates new objects written after replication is enabled

flashcards.front: A company's application uses a 3-tier architecture with an ALB, Auto Scaling group, and RDS. The application has an aggressive RTO of 5 minutes. Which DR approach is the ONLY feasible option?
flashcards.back: A 5-minute RTO is extremely aggressive. Only a multi-site active-active strategy can reliably achieve this — both regions are already serving production traffic, so 'failover' is simply adjusting Route 53 weights or removing the failed region's endpoint. Warm standby scale-up can take minutes but may exceed 5 minutes. Pilot light provisioning and backup/restore both take 15+ minutes minimum.

flashcards.front: An application uses an Aurora MySQL cluster. During a major incident, the primary writer instance fails. The application continues to throw connection errors 10 minutes after the incident. What is the MOST likely cause?
flashcards.back: Aurora automatic failover typically completes in under 30 seconds for an existing read replica to become the new primary. If errors persist 10 minutes later, the application is likely using a hardcoded IP address of the old primary rather than the Aurora cluster endpoint (DNS CNAME). The cluster endpoint automatically updates to the new primary, but applications using IPs bypass this. Always use the cluster endpoint DNS name.

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer needs to create a golden AMI that automatically incorporates the latest OS patches and installs specific packages every week. The resulting AMI should be distributed to three AWS regions. Which service provides this automated AMI build pipeline?
pairs.option: EC2 Image Builder with an image pipeline, recipe, and distribution settings targeting multiple regions

pairs.stem: A company uses RDS MySQL in a Multi-AZ deployment. During a maintenance window, the primary DB instance in us-east-1a fails. How long does the typical RDS Multi-AZ automatic failover take, and what is its impact on the connection string?
pairs.option: Failover takes 15-30 minutes; RDS sends a CloudWatch event that triggers Lambda to update the application configuration

pairs.stem: A team has 50 EC2 instances in different accounts that need to run a custom shell script for emergency remediation. The script must run immediately with results reported centrally. Which SSM feature is best suited for this immediate one-time execution?
pairs.option: SSM Automation with an ExecuteScript action distributed to all instances

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer deploys a CloudFormation stack but notices that the actual resources differ from the template definition — someone manually modified an EC2 security group directly in the console. Which CloudFormation feature detects this and what does it report?
pairs.option: CloudFormation Stack Drift Detection compares actual resource configurations against the stack's expected template configuration and reports drifted resources

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer needs to create an automated backup strategy for EC2 instances running a stateful application. Backups must occur daily, be retained for 30 days, and also be copied to a second AWS region. Which service provides this capability with the LEAST custom code?
pairs.option: AWS Backup with a backup plan specifying daily frequency, 30-day retention,.

pairs.stem: A CloudFormation stack update is attempted but fails midway. Some resources are successfully updated while others are not. The engineer needs to preview what resource changes will be made before executing another update. Which feature should be used?
pairs.option: CloudFormation Drift Detection to see what changed from the expected state

nodes.title: Part 3: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 3. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: A Service Catalog product based on a CloudFormation template needs to be updated to use a newer AMI ID. The constraint is that developers using the product should not be able to modify the AMI ID parameter when provisioning. How should the SysOps engineer configure this?
flashcards.back: Service Catalog Template Constraints allow administrators to restrict the values users can enter for CloudFormation parameters at provisioning time. By specifying allowed values or making the AMI ID parameter a fixed value using a constraint, you prevent users from overriding it with unapproved AMIs. Uploading a new product version with the updated template provides the update path. and add a 'Template Constraint' to restrict the AMI ID parameter to allowed values

flashcards.front: A SysOps engineer needs to verify that all EC2 instances in a fleet are running the latest approved AMI from the organization's image catalog. Non-compliant instances should be reported and optionally replaced automatically. Which solution addresses this most effectively?
flashcards.back: AWS Config managed rule 'approved-amis-by-id' (or 'approved-amis-by-tag') evaluates EC2 instances against an approved AMI list. Non-compliant instances are flagged in the Config compliance dashboard. Config auto-remediation can be configured to trigger an SSM Automation document that replaces the instance. This provides continuous compliance evaluation without custom Lambda code. then configure auto-remediation via SSM Automation to replace non-compliant instances

flashcards.front: GuardDuty generates a finding type 'UnauthorizedAccess:EC2/SSHBruteForce' for an EC2 instance. The SysOps engineer needs to automatically block the source IP addresses identified in the finding. What is the MOST automated approach?
flashcards.back: GuardDuty does not natively block traffic — it generates findings. The recommended automated remediation pattern uses EventBridge: create a rule matching GuardDuty finding type 'UnauthorizedAccess:EC2/SSHBruteForce', trigger a Lambda function that parses the finding for the attacker IP, then updates a Network ACL deny rule or WAF IP set. This provides near-real-time automated threat response.

flashcards.front: A company uses AWS Organizations with 15 member accounts. The security team wants to prevent any account from disabling CloudTrail or modifying CloudTrail logs. Which control provides the strongest enforcement?
flashcards.back: Service Control Policies (SCPs) applied at the AWS Organizations root or OU level override IAM permissions in member accounts — even account administrators cannot perform denied actions. An SCP denying cloudtrail:StopLogging, cloudtrail:DeleteTrail, and cloudtrail:UpdateTrail prevents ANY identity in member accounts from disabling CloudTrail, providing the strongest preventive control. IAM permission boundaries only apply to IAM entities, not the root user. cloudtrail:DeleteTrail, and cloudtrail:UpdateTrail

pairs.stem: A company's compliance requirement mandates that all KMS customer-managed keys must be rotated at least once per year. A SysOps engineer needs to enforce this automatically. What is the SIMPLEST method?
pairs.option: Enable automatic key rotation on each customer-managed KMS key,.

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer needs to identify all S3 buckets in a specific AWS account that may contain personally identifiable information (PII) such as social security numbers or credit card numbers. Which service should the engineer use?
pairs.option: AWS Config with S3 bucket access logging to detect PII in access logs

pairs.stem: A company has two VPCs in the same AWS region: VPC-A (10.0.0.0/16) and VPC-B (172.16.0.0/16). Resources in both VPCs need to communicate privately. The SysOps engineer sets up VPC peering. After creation, instances in VPC-A still cannot reach instances in VPC-B. What is MOST likely missing?
pairs.option: VPC peering requires both VPCs to be in the same AWS account

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer needs to assess EC2 instances for known CVEs, CIS benchmark compliance, and network exposure findings. The findings should be prioritized by severity and associated with specific package versions. Which AWS service provides this?
pairs.option: AWS Inspector v2 with EC2 scanning enabled.

pairs.stem: A company stores sensitive customer data in S3 buckets across multiple accounts. The security team wants a single view of all security findings, compliance status, and Inspector results across all accounts. Which service provides this aggregated security posture view?
pairs.option: AWS Security Hub with cross-account aggregation enabled and all supported integrations (GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, Config) turned on

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer needs to verify that no S3 bucket in the account is publicly accessible. The check should be continuous and run whenever a new bucket is created. Which solution has the LOWEST operational overhead?
pairs.option: Create an EventBridge rule on 'CreateBucket' API calls that triggers a Lambda function to check and block public access

nodes.title: Part 4: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 4. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: An application requires low-latency, highly available internet-facing access to UDP-based traffic on port 53 (DNS) and TCP port 443. Which AWS load balancer should the SysOps engineer deploy?
flashcards.back: Network Load Balancers operate at Layer 4 (TCP/UDP) and support TCP, UDP, TCP_UDP, and TLS listeners. NLB handles millions of requests per second with ultra-low latency. For UDP port 53 traffic, NLB is the only AWS load balancer option (ALB only supports HTTP/HTTPS). NLB also supports static Elastic IP addresses per availability zone, which is valuable for DNS services that require stable IPs. and TLS protocols

flashcards.front: A company's website is distributed globally via CloudFront. The origin is an ALB in us-east-1. Users in Asia are experiencing slow first-byte times for dynamic content that cannot be cached. How can CloudFront reduce latency for these dynamic requests?
flashcards.back: CloudFront Origin Shield is an additional caching layer in a specific AWS region between edge locations and the origin. For dynamic content that cannot be cached, Origin Shield still benefits performance by routing traffic through the AWS backbone network (rather than the public internet) from the edge location to the origin. This reduces RTT and network jitter, particularly for users far from the origin region.

flashcards.front: A SysOps engineer needs to give a third-party auditor application running in the auditor's AWS account access to read-only CloudWatch metrics from the company's AWS account. What is the MOST secure approach?
flashcards.back: Cross-account IAM roles are the AWS best practice for granting external accounts access. The role in the company's account has a trust policy specifying the auditor's account ID as a trusted principal. The auditor's application calls sts:AssumeRole to get temporary credentials scoped to read-only CloudWatch access. This avoids sharing long-lived credentials and is revocable at any time by modifying the role. with read-only CloudWatch permissions

flashcards.front: A company connects its on-premises data center to AWS using AWS Site-to-Site VPN. Users report intermittent connectivity failures to the VPN. The SysOps engineer checks and finds the VPN has only one tunnel active. What should the engineer do to improve availability?
flashcards.back: Each AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection provides two tunnels for redundancy — each tunnel connects to a different endpoint in a different AWS Availability Zone. Many customer gateway devices only bring up one tunnel. The correct fix is to configure both tunnel endpoints on the customer gateway device (customer-side VPN appliance), enable both tunnels, and configure routing (BGP preferred) to use both. AWS then maintains HA within the VPN connection. and configure BGP or static routes for both tunnel IPs

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer needs to securely access EC2 instances in a private subnet for administration without opening inbound SSH or RDP ports and without requiring a bastion host. Which AWS service enables this?
pairs.option: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager.

pairs.stem: AWS Trusted Advisor reports that an account has 15 EC2 instances with very low CPU utilization (average < 5%) over the past 2 weeks. The SysOps engineer needs to provide right-sizing recommendations with specific instance type suggestions. Which AWS service provides detailed right-sizing recommendations based on CloudWatch metric analysis?
pairs.option: AWS Compute Optimizer, which analyzes CloudWatch CPU.

pairs.stem: A company connects its on-premises data center to AWS using AWS Site-to-Site VPN. Users report intermittent connectivity failures to the VPN. The SysOps engineer checks and finds the VPN has only one tunnel active. What should the engineer do to improve availability?
pairs.option: Upgrade from static routing to BGP routing on the existing VPN connection

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer needs to give a third-party auditor application running in the auditor's AWS account access to read-only CloudWatch metrics from the company's AWS account. What is the MOST secure approach?
pairs.option: Enable CloudWatch cross-account observability and use a monitoring account to pull metrics from the source account

pairs.stem: An application requires low-latency, highly available internet-facing access to UDP-based traffic on port 53 (DNS) and TCP port 443. Which AWS load balancer should the SysOps engineer deploy?
pairs.option: Network Load Balancer (NLB) which operates at Layer 4 and supports TCP, UDP,.

pairs.stem: A SysOps engineer needs to expose an internal application running on EC2 instances to other AWS accounts without VPC peering or Transit Gateway. The solution must not expose the service to the internet. Which AWS service enables this?
pairs.option: S3 presigned URL-based file sharing between accounts
